## Description

Context: what we decided and why. Medvya approves the organisation only. A false licence is the organisation's liability, so the terms and DPA must say so in plain words, and a Hospital signs the DPA before approval.
What to build. New terms and DPA version stating that Medvya does not verify individual doctors, that the owner is responsible for who they add and for attesting each licence including the effect of a false attestation, and that Medvya may suspend an organisation. Bump TermsPolicy (ITermsAcceptance.cs) so owners re-accept through the existing terms gate. The attestation step shows a short reminder. Counsel reviews the document lists too. Counsel's written sign-off of this wording before use with a real pilot clinic is an acceptance criterion of MDV-P1-044, which owns the legal review; until it exists the draft marker blocks deploys beyond dev.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the new version, when an owner signs in, then they must accept it before booking or messaging (existing gate).
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the attestation step, when shown, then it carries the plain-language reminder in en, hi and ar.

## Test notes

- Integration on real PostgreSQL: version bump forces re-acceptance.
- Playwright: consents and terms spec updated.
- Browser: English and Arabic.
